title: Privileged role assignments without MFA enforcement
description: Evaluates whether privileged users and administrative role assignments are protected by MFA and admin-focused conditional access.
risk: An attacker who compromises an unprotected privileged identity can alter cloud resources, disable controls, exfiltrate data, or create persistence.
confidence_penalties: reduce confidence when tenant-wide Conditional Access is not observable
reduce confidence when MFA state is inferred from partial role inventory

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure multi-factor authentication is enabled for all privileged users
Identities are proofed and bound to credentials
Use access controls to protect accounts and services
compliance_mappings.relevance: SME-oriented baseline for privileged access protection

compliance_mappings.title: Security of processing
compliance_mappings.relevance: Protection of administrative access to systems handling personal data

compliance_mappings.title: A firm must establish and maintain effective systems and controls
compliance_mappings.relevance: Identity control baseline for regulated SME environments

remediation.summary: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.
manual_steps: Review all privileged role assignments and confirm each principal has a named owner.
Require MFA for privileged users and emergency access accounts through an approved policy.
Create a decision record for any exception, including expiry and compensating control.

code.label: List Azure role assignments for review

title: Administrative services are exposed to the public internet
description: Evaluates whether SSH or RDP administrative services are reachable from the public internet.
risk: Public administrative ports increase the likelihood of brute-force access, credential stuffing, exploitation, and rapid compromise of cloud workloads.
confidence_penalties: reduce confidence when network rules are observed without resolved workload context
reduce confidence when exposure is aggregated rather than asset-specific

compliance_mappings.title: Restrict network access to management ports
Use firewalls to secure internet connections
compliance_mappings.relevance: SME baseline for restricting internet-reachable admin services

compliance_mappings.title: A firm must establish and maintain effective systems and controls
compliance_mappings.relevance: Boundary control expectation for regulated environments

remediation.summary: Restrict SSH and RDP exposure with private access paths, VPN, or just-in-time controls.
manual_steps: Identify the exposed workload, rule, source range, and business owner.
Replace public administrative access with VPN, private endpoint, bastion, or just-in-time access.
Record any temporary exposure as a time-bound governance exception.

code.label: List NSG rules for administrative ports
code.snippet: az network nsg rule list --resource-group <resource-group> --nsg-name <nsg-name> --output table

title: Public storage access increases data exposure risk
description: Evaluates whether storage services allow public or anonymous access that could expose sensitive SME data.
risk: Public data paths can expose personal, financial, or operational records and weaken the defensibility of GDPR and customer assurance claims.
confidence_penalties: reduce confidence when data sensitivity is sector-inferred rather than asset-specific
reduce confidence when storage exposure is visible but container-level access is unavailable

compliance_mappings.title: Security of processing
compliance_mappings.relevance: Protection of personal data from public cloud exposure

remediation.summary: Disable anonymous or public storage access and review data exposure paths.
manual_steps: Confirm whether public storage access is intentional and documented.
Disable public access for sensitive storage unless a signed exception exists.
Review exposed data paths and notify accountable business owners where required.

code.label: Disable blob public access on a storage account

title: Activity log retention is below governance and investigation expectations
description: Evaluates whether activity log retention supports investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.
risk: Short retention windows can prevent incident reconstruction, weaken assurance evidence, and leave board or insurer questions unanswered.
confidence_penalties: reduce confidence when only default platform retention is visible
reduce confidence when diagnostic destination coverage is unavailable

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure that activity log alerts exist for create, update, or delete operations
Networks and network services are monitored
Personal confidential data is handled in secure and supported systems
compliance_mappings.relevance: Monitoring evidence and secure operational visibility for health-related environments

remediation.summary: Increase log retention to support investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.
manual_steps: Set an activity log retention period that matches the SME governance and incident review window.
Route important logs to a monitored workspace or archive destination.
Document retention costs and any constrained-scope exception.

code.label: List diagnostic settings for a subscription
code.snippet: az monitor diagnostic-settings subscription list --output table

title: Resource tagging coverage falls below governance expectations
description: Evaluates whether cloud resources carry enough tags to support ownership, cost accountability, and assurance drilldown.
risk: Weak tagging makes it harder to identify resource owners, explain spending, assign remediation, or support asset inventory claims.
confidence_penalties: reduce confidence when resource inventory is sampled rather than complete
reduce confidence when required tag policy is not observable

compliance_mappings.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets

remediation.summary: Apply and enforce required resource tags across the environment.
manual_steps: Define required ownership, environment, service, and data-classification tags.
Prioritize tagging resources linked to open findings or sensitive data paths.
Use policy or review workflow evidence to show tagging remains current.

code.label: Apply a tag to a resource
